title: Finding the Furry Cat! (Inside / Outside, Top / Bottom, Near / Far)
description: Playful interactive kitten, tent, tree, and pond simulation to master Inside/Outside, Top/Bottom, and Near/Far concepts.
learningObjectives: Distinguish and apply the concepts of Inside and Outside
Identify Top and Bottom spatial positions on trees and shelves
Evaluate relative distance: Near and Far from reference landmarks
Develop spatial vocabulary through tactile manipulation and audio read-aloud prompts

title: Rolling or Sliding? The Ramp Adventure!
description: Hands-on physics ramp adventure: test balls, boxes, coins, and batteries to discover which objects roll, slide, or do both!
learningObjectives: Distinguish between objects with round/curved surfaces and flat surfaces
Understand why round objects roll and flat objects slide on an incline
Discover objects like coins and batteries that can both roll and slide depending on how they are placed
Predict which shapes can be stacked into tall towers without toppling

title: Counting in the Enchanted Garden (Numbers 1 to 9 & The Zero Concept)
description: Gather mangoes, butterflies, and flowers into a 2x5 Ten-Frame basket with auditory tally, and explore the concept of Zero in the baby bird nest.
learningObjectives: Develop 1-to-1 correspondence by counting objects up to 9 with pitch-matched audio
Recognize numerals 1–9 and connect quantities with number names in English & Hindi
Understand structured base-10 counting using a visual 2x5 Ten-Frame
Internalize the concept of Zero (शून्य) as an empty set or absence of items

title: The Great Animal Balancing Act! (Longer/Shorter, Heavier/Lighter, Taller/Shorter)
description: Hands-on pan balance and measurement lab: compare heavy vs light with tilting scales, tall vs short from a common baseline, and measure with tiled units!
learningObjectives: Compare weights using an interactive physical pan balance (Tarazu) to identify Heavier and Lighter
Compare heights and lengths from a strict common baseline to determine Taller/Shorter and Longer/Shorter
Measure lengths using concrete non-standard unit tiling (paperclips / blocks)
Develop foundational spatial and measurement vocabulary in English and Hindi

title: Addition & Subtraction Stories (Adding and Taking Away up to 9)
description: Interactive addition and subtraction story adventures: make frogs hop together on lily pads, watch birds fly away from tree branches, and solve concrete word problem challenges!
learningObjectives: Understand addition as combining two collections and counting on up to 9
Understand subtraction as taking away objects from a collection (how many are left?)
Connect real-world pictorial stories to symbolic math equations (A + B = C, A - B = C)
Reinforce number sense using dual-color Ten-Frame visual organizers

title: The Rhythmic Pattern Train! (Repeating Sequences & Shapes)
description: Complete the missing pattern carriages on the steam train! Hear the rhythmic chimes, discover ABAB, AABB, and ABC sequences, and watch the train chug happily!
learningObjectives: Identify and extend repeating patterns in colors, shapes, and familiar objects (ABAB, AABB, ABC)
Develop auditory pattern recognition by matching visual sequences to musical chime rhythms
Understand the concept of the core repeating unit in foundational mathematics
Strengthen spatial reasoning and logical sequencing through hands-on train carriages

title: A Day in the Life of Chintu! (Time, Sequences & Daily Routines)
description: Join Chintu through morning, afternoon, evening, and night! Arrange his daily routine in chronological order and discover what happens earlier and later!
learningObjectives: Recognize and name the four major parts of the day: Morning, Afternoon, Evening, and Night
Sequence routine daily activities in correct chronological order from sunrise to bedtime
Develop foundational comparative temporal concepts: Earlier vs Later, Before vs After
Associate visual environmental cues (sun rising, midday sun, sunset, starry moon) with time of day

title: The Village Toy Shop! (Indian Currency ₹1, ₹2, ₹5, ₹10 & Bundling 10s and 1s)
description: Visit the vibrant village toy shop! Count and combine Indian coins (₹1, ₹2, ₹5, ₹10) to buy wooden spinning tops, kites, and clay elephants, and tie sticks into bundles of 10!
learningObjectives: Recognize and name Indian currency denominations: ₹1, ₹2, ₹5, and ₹10 coins and notes
Combine different coin denominations to pay the exact price for items up to ₹20
Understand place-value grouping: 10 loose units form 1 Bundle of Ten (दहाई और इकाई)
Develop foundational financial literacy and mental addition in everyday contexts
topicName: Money & Place Value: Coins, Notes & Bundling Tens and Ones

title: Number Village: Read, Build & Compare (1 to 99)
description: Explore the village to count items, build numbers with tens and ones, compare quantities, and find missing sequence cards.
learningObjectives: Read and write 2-digit numerals up to 99 with place value insight (LO M201)
Count objects in groups of tens and loose ones (LO M202)
Compare two 2-digit numbers using <, >, and = (LO M202)
Identify missing numbers in a sequential number path (LO M201)

title: Tens and Ones Workshop: Bundling Lab
description: Drag loose sticks into bundles of ten! Discover that 10 ones make exactly 1 ten bundle without changing the total count.
learningObjectives: Group 10 loose ones into 1 ten-rod (bundling conservation) (LO M202)
Unbundle 1 ten into 10 loose ones (LO M202)
Express numbers in standard and expanded form (e.g., 34 = 3 tens + 4 ones)
topicName: Place Value & Bundling 10 Ones into 1 Ten

title: Rupee and Paise Play Market (₹1 to ₹100)
description: Pay for classroom market items using authentic Indian play currency coins (₹1, ₹2, ₹5) and notes (₹10, ₹20, ₹50).
learningObjectives: Recognize and combine Indian currency denominations: ₹1, ₹2, ₹5, ₹10, ₹20, ₹50 (LO M208)
Pay exact amounts up to ₹100 using combinations of notes and coins
Realize that the same monetary amount can be paid in multiple coin/note combinations

title: Shape Explorer: Flat Shapes and Solid Objects
description: Explore 3D solids (cube, sphere, cylinder, cone) and test whether they roll, slide, or do both on an inclined ramp.
learningObjectives: Observe and identify 3D solids: cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone, sphere (LO M209)
Distinguish curved surfaces from flat surfaces
Demonstrate why curved surfaces roll while flat surfaces slide

title: Length Detective: Measure with Uniform Units
description: Measure virtual classroom objects using equal paper clips, pencils, and erasers placed end-to-end without gaps or overlaps.
learningObjectives: Estimate and measure lengths using uniform non-standard units (paper clips, erasers) (LO M211)
Understand why measuring units must be placed end-to-end without gaps or overlap
Compare lengths of two classroom objects measured with the same unit

title: Living, Non-Living & Once-Living Sorter
description: Hands-on classification of living things, non-living objects, and things made from once-living nature (NCF-FS CG-8).
learningObjectives: Distinguish living things from non-living objects using observable features (NCF-FS CG-8)
Understand that objects made of wood or dried leaves are once-living materials
Recognize that autonomous movement alone does not define living things (e.g. toy cars)

title: Plant Parts & Plant Needs Garden
description: Assemble roots, stem, leaves, and flowers, then balance sunlight, water, and soil to nurture the plant to bloom.
learningObjectives: Identify basic plant parts: roots, stem, leaves, flowers (NCF-FS CG-8)
Understand why roots absorb water and hold the plant in soil
Demonstrate that plants need balanced sunlight and water to produce flowers

title: Human Body & Five Senses Explorer
description: Discover how our eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin safely help us observe and learn about the world (NCF-FS CG-8).
learningObjectives: Identify the five senses and their organs: eyes, ears, nose, tongue, skin (NCF-FS CG-8)
Match sensory observations with the corresponding sense organ
Follow personal safety rules: never smell unknown chemicals or touch hot surfaces

title: Water Around Us & Water Conservation Lab
description: Find leaking taps, turn off taps while brushing, and harvest rainwater to protect our precious water supply (NCF-FS CG-9).
learningObjectives: Identify everyday uses and vital importance of clean water (NCF-FS CG-9)
Practice water-saving habits: closing taps during brushing, repairing leaks
Understand rainwater harvesting as a way to replenish water reserves

title: Sink or Float Discovery Lab
description: Predict whether everyday objects will sink or float in a water tub, then test and observe buoyancy (NCF-FS CG-8).
learningObjectives: Predict and observe whether common objects sink or float in water (NCF-FS CG-8)
Understand that hollow shapes with trapped air (like boats) float easily
Follow the scientific inquiry cycle: Predict -> Test -> Observe -> Explain

title: Push, Pull, and Movement Playground
description: Push and pull a toy cart across ice, wood, and rough carpet to observe how forces start motion and surfaces slow it down (NCF-FS CG-8).
learningObjectives: Explore pushes (moving away) and pulls (drawing closer) as causes of motion (NCF-FS CG-8)
Observe qualitatively how rough surfaces like carpet stop moving objects faster than smooth ice
Demonstrate how changing force direction reverses the movement direction

title: Counting and Number Recognition
description: Count objects arranged in ten-frames and match the quantity to its numeral and number name.
learningObjectives: Count objects up to 20
Recognise numerals 1–20
Read and say number names
See numbers above 10 as ten and some more

title: Addition with Objects
description: Put two groups of objects together and count all of them to find the sum.
learningObjectives: Understand addition as putting together
Count on to add
Write an addition sentence

title: Place Value
description: Build a number with hundred-flats, ten-rods and unit cubes and read its expanded form.
learningObjectives: Identify the place value of each digit
Represent numbers with base-ten blocks
Write numbers in expanded form

title: Addition and Subtraction on a Number Line
description: Jump forwards to add and backwards to subtract on a number line, in tens and then ones.
learningObjectives: Add and subtract two-digit numbers
Use jumps of tens and ones
Relate addition and subtraction
